title: ChatGPT Ko Ye Prompt Do 🤯 | Better AI Answers in Seconds #Shorts
hook: ChatGPT ko sirf sawal mat poochiye... isay ye prompt dein!
voiceover: ChatGPT ko sirf sawal mat poochiye... isay ye prompt dein! Zyada tar log AI ko sirf ek simple question dete hain, is liye unhein average answer milta hai. Better result ke liye ChatGPT ko 4 cheezein batayein: Role, Goal, Context aur Format. Example: You are a professional marketing expert. Mera goal hai YouTube channel grow karna. Mujhe 5 practical ideas table ki form mein do. Ab dekhein... AI ko clear instructions milin, aur answer bhi zyada specific ho gaya. Better prompt, better result. IT Doctor AI ko follow karein for daily AI and IT tips.
